description.zh: 在自己的几台 Windows 电脑和 Mac（Mac顺）之间同步剪贴板：文字、图片、文件，端到端加密，不用账号
description.en: Share the clipboard between your Windows PCs and Macs (Mac顺): text, pictures, files; end to end encrypted, no account

notes.zh: 剪贴板同步（新插件）：在自己的几台 Windows 电脑和装了 Mac顺 的 Mac 之间同步剪贴板，这边复制，那边直接粘贴文字、图片、文件和文件夹。第一次在新的那台上打 `同步`，选“附近的「…」”请求加入，另一台显示同一串 6 位数字时同意就行；不在同一个网段时可以用邀请码。别的设备复制的文件先提示，按 Enter 接收并放进剪贴板，Ctrl+Enter 存到“下载”。端到端加密（X25519 + AES-256-GCM），不用账号，不经过任何服务器；密码管理器复制的内容不同步。需要 Win顺 0.42.0。权限：联网、在本机监听 TCP 37219 和 UDP 37220（让组里的设备连进来、找到附近的设备）、读写剪贴板、写文件（收到的文件）、通知。
notes.en: Clipboard sync (new plugin): copy on one of your Windows PCs or Macs running Mac顺, paste on another: text, pictures, files and folders. Pair once: on the new device, pick the other's "… nearby" row in `sync`, and agree on the other when both show the same six digits; an invite code works across networks. Files copied elsewhere are offered first: Enter receives them onto the clipboard, Ctrl+Enter into Downloads. End to end encrypted (X25519 + AES-256-GCM), no account, no server; password managers' copies are not synced. Needs WinShun 0.42.0. Permissions: network, listening on TCP 37219 and UDP 37220 on this PC (for the group's devices to connect and to find devices nearby), clipboard read and write, writing files (those received), notifications.
